Delivery verification

Prepared and checked 4 November 2026. The package contains 60 required proposed web templates plus 3 optional templates, 256 field definitions, 301 controls/actions, 304 page states, 76 dialogs, 209 page acceptance scenarios and 12 connected journeys. These counts describe specification entries, not implemented features. The frontend progress checklist starts at Not started / Not run for implementation and browser review.

Checks performed

  • Parsed both authoring JSON arrays and checked exact page/nested schemas, unique page IDs/routes, role values, scope, action/state/acceptance coverage and W/O references.
  • Generated the consolidated page catalogue, HTML report, route/legacy inventories, field/action/state/dialog CSVs and an implementation checklist. All 32 included historical academic S/P entries have a crosswalk.
  • Verified all 23 research evidence entries reference the source registers. They contain 21 distinct public source URLs; duplicates across workstreams are not independent sources. An independent review sampled publisher revision dates against the pages.
  • Verified Markdown local links, report fragment/label references, page-section coverage, no report runtime network assets, and a complete package hash inventory.
  • Ran the actual report search/filter script using Node DOM doubles: page search, optional filtering, hidden-section link recovery, syntax and print-rule presence passed. This is not browser rendering or screen-reader evidence.
  • Recomputed fixture grades: released learner 84.50%, staff 85.17%, separate configurable-policy example 82.00%. Checked timer/hard-close examples, TA no-release fixture, captured group membership and local PDF/text specimen presence.
  • Reviewed source contracts and pages for TA permissions, grade release/history, status-only and policy-only releases, group recipients, request response loops, private calendar data, quiz expiry, before-close demo scenarios and optional scope. Concrete findings were corrected before packaging.

The delivery process also extracts the created ZIP into a fresh temporary directory and reruns the read-only package verifier and report-controller check there. Archive integrity and extraction verification results are reported with the final deliverable. Re-run the included verifier on your extracted copy before edits.

Limits

No product UI was built or changed by this handoff. No browser visual, responsive, keyboard, screen-reader, native-device or production integration acceptance was performed. No accessibility certification, security assurance, primary customer validation or real upload/delivery success is claimed. Newly specified policies/routes are proposed defaults. Use FRONTEND_CHECKLIST.csv to record actual implementation and design review later.

Reproduce

Run python tools/verify_handoff.py (Windows: py -3 tools/verify_handoff.py). If Node is installed, run node tools/check_report.cjs. The Python verifier is read-only and needs only the standard library; the Node check has no external packages. To intentionally regenerate documentation after source edits, run python tools/build_handoff.py --refresh-manifest, then verify again.
